# Requirements Quality Checklist: Deterministic OpenAI and Anthropic simulators with fault injection

**Purpose**: Reviewer gate on completeness, testability, security, privacy and performance budget of the 002 requirements
**Created**: 2026-11-05
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all endpoints of both flavours listed with their modes (streaming, non-streaming, encodings)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §FR-003]
- [x] CHK002 Is every fault type named with its parameters and both ways to set it (start-up, live)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK003 Are error responses specified per provider, including missing auth and unknown model? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, §FR-016, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK004 Is shutdown behaviour specified for in-flight streams? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020]
- [x] CHK005 Are the provider-specific required fields (Anthropic `max_tokens`) and unsupported features (`n > 1`, `stop`) covered? [Completeness, Edge Cases]

## Requirement Clarity and Testability

- [x] CHK006 Are latency expectations stated with explicit tolerances rather than "about"? [Clarity, Spec §US3 AS1]
- [x] CHK007 Is determinism defined precisely (what is identical, what is excluded, under concurrency)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, §FR-019, §SC-004]
- [x] CHK008 Is the token-count error defined against a named reference tokenizer and corpus? [Testability, Spec §SC-006, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK009 Is "matches the official shape" testable through committed fixtures with cited sources? [Testability, Spec §FR-012, §SC-002]
- [x] CHK010 Is SDK compatibility defined by a concrete client matrix (3 languages × 2 providers)? [Testability, Spec §SC-001]

## Security

- [x] CHK011 Is the unauthenticated admin API constrained by a safe default bind address? [Security, Spec §FR-018]
- [x] CHK012 Is it explicit that the simulator never contacts a real provider and accepts any key value? [Security, Spec §FR-015, §FR-016]
- [x] CHK013 Are auth header values kept out of the simulator's own logs? [Security, Spec §FR-010]

## Privacy

- [x] CHK014 Is the request log scoped to test traffic and excluded from regular logs? [Privacy, Spec §FR-010, Assumptions]

## Performance Budget

- [x] CHK015 Is a throughput floor defined with measurement conditions? [Performance, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK016 Is timer accuracy under concurrency bounded so the simulator does not distort overhead numbers? [Performance, Spec §SC-007]
- [x] CHK017 Is memory bounded for very long outputs? [Performance, Edge Cases]

## Edge Cases and Dependencies

- [x] CHK018 Is the behaviour defined when the embeddings forward target fails? [Edge Case, Spec Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK019 Are invalid fault configurations (rates summing above 1) rejected? [Edge Case, Spec Edge Cases, data-model]
- [x] CHK020 Are the SDK toolchain dependencies for CI documented? [Dependency, Assumptions]

## Notes

- Review pass 1 found gaps in CHK004, CHK005, CHK006, CHK013, CHK016 and CHK018; the spec was updated
  (US3 AS1, FR-010, FR-020, Edge Cases, SC-007) before ticking.
